# Design 4.2 row 5 and the WORKSPACE signature of rules_nodejs (design 2.7):
# legacy `npm_install` and `yarn_install`, which exist up to 5.8.5.

=== .bazelversion
6.6.0
=== WORKSPACE
workspace(name = "legacy")

load("@bazel_tools//tools/build_defs/repo:http.bzl", "http_archive")

http_archive(
    name = "build_bazel_rules_nodejs",
    urls = ["https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_nodejs/releases/download/5.8.5/rules_nodejs-5.8.5.tar.gz"],
)

load("@build_bazel_rules_nodejs//:repositories.bzl", "build_bazel_rules_nodejs_dependencies")

build_bazel_rules_nodejs_dependencies()

load("@build_bazel_rules_nodejs//:index.bzl", "node_repositories", "npm_install", "yarn_install")

node_repositories()

npm_install(
    name = "npm",
    package_json = "//:package.json",
    package_lock_json = "//:package-lock.json",
)

yarn_install(
    name = "web_deps",
    package_json = "//web:package.json",
    yarn_lock = "//web:yarn.lock",
)
=== package.json
{}
=== package-lock.json
{"lockfileVersion": 2, "packages": {}}
=== web/package.json
{}
=== web/yarn.lock
# yarn lockfile v1
